article.title: Russian attacks cause new power outages in five regions, Ukrenergo says
article.summary: As of the morning of September 3, Russian attacks have left new consumers without power in five regions; in the Odesa region, grid restrictions are in effect due to the aftermath of the September 2 attack.

article.title: Russian occupation court sentences captured Ukrainian journalist Levchenko to 15 years in prison
article.summary: The Russian occupation "Zaporizhzhia Regional Court" has sentenced Melitopol journalist Iryna Levchenko to 15 years in prison. She was abducted by Russian forces in 2023.

article.title: Russian forces launch nearly 40 attacks on Sumy region over past day, eight civilians injured
article.summary: Russian forces launched nearly 40 attacks on 24 settlements in the Sumy region over the past day, injuring eight people.

article.title: Ukraine's General Staff confirms strike on Russian Kasta radar worth at least US$60m
article.summary: Ukraine's General Staff has confirmed that a drone strike destroyed a Russian Kasta radar station in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, valued at over US$60 million.

article.title: No evidence found of FPV drones launched from jet-powered UAVs in Russian attacks on Kyiv
article.summary: Serhii Beskrestnov, a freelance presidential advisor, known by his call sign "Flash," has said that no evidence has been found over the past three days that FPV drones launched from jet-powered Shahed-type drones had been used during Russian attacks on Kyiv.

article.title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,440 over past day
article.summary: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to September 4, 2026, have reached approximately 1,493,790 personnel, including 1,440 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

article.title: Injury toll from Russia's Sept 3 drone strikes on Kyiv rises to 14
article.summary: Fourteen people, including a 12-year-old girl, were injured in Kyiv on September 3 as fragments of Russian drones were reported to have fallen in the capital's Holosiivskyi, Darnytskyi, Sviatoshynskyi and Solomianskyi districts.

article.title: Enemy probing Ukrainian defenses in Vovchansk community for about a week – SBGS spokesperson
article.summary: Russian forces have been trying to "probe" Ukrainian defenses in the Vovchansk community of the Kharkiv region for about a week.

article.title: Injury toll in Russian strike on Kherson rises to 12, one killed
article.summary: The number of people injured in a drone attack on a minibus and a car in Kherson has risen to 12, while one person was killed.

article.title: Injury toll in Russian attack on Kyiv region rises to four, warehouses and homes damaged
article.summary: Two more people were injured in a Russian attack on the Kyiv region on September 3; private homes were damaged in the Fastiv district.

article.title: General Staff confirms destruction of Russian landing craft, EW system, drone command post and warehouses
article.summary: On September 2 and during the night of September 3, 2026, units of the Ukrainian Defense Forces struck a number of enemy military targets, including a BK-16 landing craft, an electronic warfare system, a UAV command post, and enemy warehouses.

article.title: Russian forces strike forest administrative building in Zaporizhzhia Oblast – photos
article.summary: Russian forces have struck an administrative building belonging to the Zaporizhzhia Forest Branch, shattering all its windows and doors, severely damaging the roof and burning out four offices.

article.title: Zelensky orders push to speed up production of interceptors for jet-powered Shaheds
article.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky emphasized the need to speed up the production of high-speed interceptors to counter jet-powered Shahed drones.

article.title: Russian forces attack four districts of Kyiv region with drones, damaging 34 sites
article.summary: Russian forces have attacked the Fastiv, Bucha, Boryspil and Brovary districts of the Kyiv region with strike drones, damaging warehouses, homes, a business and a religious building.

article.title: Ukraine confirms shutdown of Russian oil refinery and strategic port after Ukrainian strikes
article.summary: Ukraine's General Staff said drones hit pipelines and processing units at the Lukoil and Novatek sites, causing fires and oil product spills.

article.title: Oil depot catches fire in Sochi after drone attack
article.summary: An oil depot caught fire in the early hours of September 4 following a drone attack on the city of Sochi in Russia's Krasnodar Krai and the federal territory of Sirius.

article.title: Russian attack on Dnipro kills one and injures five
article.summary: Russian invaders attacked the suburbs of Dnipro. One person was killed, and five were wounded.

article.title: Russian drone attack on car near Zaporizhzhia kills one and injures another
article.summary: The occupiers attacked the village of Bilenke in the Zaporizhzhia district with a drone. One person was killed and another wounded when the drone struck a civilian car.

article.summary: The General Staff of the Ukrainian Armed Forces has confirmed that two major oil refineries in Russia were forced to halt operations following strikes, including Lukoil-Nizhegorodnefteorgsintez in the Nizhny Novgorod region and Novatek-Ust-Luga in the Leningrad region.

article.title: Russian attack on Dnipro: eight people injured, one in serious condition
article.summary: A Russian attack on Dnipro on 3 September left at least eight people injured, with one in a critical condition.

article.title: Fire breaks out at industrial facility in Brovary after Russian drone attack
article.summary: A fire broke out at an industrial facility in Brovary, Kyiv region, following a Russian drone attack.

article.title: Russian forces launch 890 attacks in Zaporizhzhia region over past day, one killed, four injured
article.summary: Russian forces launched 890 attacks on 49 settlements in the Zaporizhzhia region over the past 24 hours. One person was killed and four others were injured in enemy attacks on Zaporizhzhia and the Zaporizhzhia district.

article.title: Ukraine hits Russian fuel depot, drone launch site and command posts
article.summary: Ukraine's General Staff has reported hits near Donetsk, in Kharkiv and Luhansk oblasts, as well as on radar and reconnaissance assets in Bryansk Oblast and occupied Crimea.

article.title: Russians strike apartment building in Odesa, eight injured
article.summary: Eight people were injured in Odesa after Russian forces launched an aerial attack, damaging a multi-story residential building.

article.title: Ukrainian forces strike UAV launch site and Russian reconnaissance assets

article.title: Ukrainian forces refute Russian claim of capturing Khrapivshchyna in Sumy region
article.summary: A claim by Russian propagandists that Russian forces have allegedly captured the village of Khrapivshchyna in the Sumy region is false.

article.title: The New Jet-Powered Drones That Are Breeding Anxiety in Ukraine
